draw_policy.default: frozen-instance-by-default: scripts/build_images.sh reads the committed qualification draw at judge/private/final_cases.json unless FINAL_CASES_PATH names another instance; every host that builds from this instance evaluates the same holdout, so raw scores are comparable across hosts for this instance
draw_policy.flop_identity: the geometries, batch sizes, seeds and the hidden half of sweep cases that run the golden are withheld; only domain, family, tier and weight are declared
draw_policy.privacy: the frozen instance lives on the Judge-only path judge/private/, is staged mode 0600 into a root-only Judge build context, is never present in the Work image and is proven absent from every Work build context by scripts/validate_layout.py; the build manifest records its SHA-256
draw_policy.redraw: scripts/generate_final_manifest.py --redraw --seed <int> draws a reproducible new instance from a seeded random.Random (default seed: int.from_bytes(sha256("<suite_id>|<task_id>").digest()[:8], "big")); no system random source is used. A redraw is a NEW suite identity: frozen_instance must be re-recorded and no earlier score is comparable to it.
